property_summary: For all inputs, only the deployer (owner) can change contract balances via sendMoney(address,uint256) — i.e., non-owners cannot cause address(c).balance to decrease — but the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner to reduce address(c).balance for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the owner restriction by replacing onlyOwner modifier body to do nothing (always allow), so sendMoney can be called by non-owners and thus change observable balances after calls by different callers.
